reviews.x: This product has me on the fence. It washes out easily which is the major bonus. It comes with a nice set of colors each individually packaged so you don't have to open it until you are ready to use that color. It is hard to get a nice base of color without kind of caking it on and then it makes your hair feel really stiff once you do. It brushes but almost makes it feel like you ate brushing dried hairspray. For someone with a lot of hair, you will need more then one individual color. It is eas

I got this to turn my 6 year old daughter's hair pink for "literary character" day at school. Pinkalicious- of course! It took awhile (she has light brown hair) but turned out AWESOME! Didn't get on clothes & washed right out! We just play with the other colors on random Saturdays!

Purchased for my Comic-Con cosplay which worked perfectly! If you're using a lot in one shot, can definitely get messy but washes right off your hands while it actually stays in hair until washed! Would & have been recommending to anyone looking for any type of temporary color!

reviews.t: Color is not as bright as advertised especially on dark ...
reviews.x: Color is not as bright as advertised especially on dark hair. Application is also not smooth, chunky pieces come off.

reviews.t: Fun, temporary, hair color for kids!
reviews.x: I purchased the hair chalk for my 1st graders "crazy hair day" at school and it worked great. It takes about 10 minutes to brush the color combs through and get the color effect you want. My son's hair is blond, so the product worked great, however I'm not sure it would have the same impact on darker hair.

reviews.t: It is more like a gross goop
reviews.x: Considering that the name of this product is "hair chalk" I was expecting a chalky formula. NOPE! It is more like a gross goop. Once applied it gums up your hair and makes it look like a stringy oily mess. It's really gross.  i would not recommend buying this.
So much fun!!  We have our mini horse a birthday party on April 8.  Theme was Unicorns and Rainbows.

My 6 yo daugher loves these.  Aren't too messy and easy to put in hair. She is blond so shows up well. You have to rub a little bit hard to get a good color, but I like the application of it. Easy to wash out when you want.
Not vibrant at all and takes a lot to even see color

The chalk is easy to apply and is only slightly moist, which makes it less messy. Make sure the hair it's being applied to is perfectly smooth- any snags will pick up a chunk of chalk. If you don't want to wash your hands after applying, make sure to wear gloves. It washes off of hands really easily, but it takes some shampoo to get it out of very blond hair. It was very vibrant in both blond and brunette hair, which I love since my daughters have opposite hair colors and I wanted them to both e

Perfect and the colors are awesome!  I've tried two different brands and ended up with my hands the same color as my hair and a mess on the counter tops and clothing.  These are no mess no fuss!  I am getting ready to buy another set!  Super idea and great product; the color don't blow out when you start to style with your blow dryer!
Well of course my results would not be like the picture, but i did hope my light brown hair daughter would get some brighter colors from it.

reviews.t: These were a great stocking stuffers for my 13 year old daughter
reviews.x: These were a great stocking stuffers for my 13 year old daughter. Easy to use and not messy. Will be ordering more.
Come off at the touch.And fall in pieces while is applying it.Don't recomend it.

reviews.t: If you're looking for a hint of color this is for you.
reviews.x: For what I was looking for this product works for me. My hair is blonde so it's very pastel not vibrant as the ad suggested. I guess if you use all of it one application it might be darker. I work in a professional atmosphere so subtle highlights of color are in order. I'm not sure I can give a recommendation. It depends on what each individual is looking for. It does wash out and I keep it from transferring with styling products.

reviews.t: A must for every little girl's party
reviews.x: My daughter bought these for my granddaughter's make-up birthday party and they were a HUGE hit! Not only did the girls get their hair colored by our visiting hair color specialist (a teenaged sister of one of the attendees) but the girls took up the chalk and colored their mom's (and grandma's) hair. I have never had so many colored streaks in my hair.

reviews.t: The chalks don't work as pictured. Even after multiple ...
reviews.x: The chalks don't work as pictured.  Even after multiple swipes of the chalk, they are barely visible - except on everything else (your hands, clothing, etc.)  And the more you swipe to get the color to show, the more greasy your hair gets.  These are very messy for the effort to get them to work. I wouldn't buy them again.

reviews.t: I had high hopes for this hair chalk for my ...
reviews.x: I had high hopes for this hair chalk for my Halloween costume this year... but I forgot that I was a brunette. Needless to say, they hardly show up at all. I could see more on my hands than my hair, even the highlighted sections. Boo.

reviews.t: Great colors (except for yellow), but too greasy!
reviews.x: This is colorful grease.... Makes your hair look colorful, but also nasty, like you've been raving for 6 days straight without sleep or showers! Would stick with the powdery hair chalks.... This is simply too messy and too oily.

reviews.t: In the light it actually glimmers!
reviews.x: I bought them for my 8 yr old daughter as a Nee Years gift. Not brushing or neglected hair  has been an issue for us since she was 4, with these- I was actually able to brush her hair with zero complaints!

Not for dark hair. The pictures are extremely deceiving. My daughter has brown hair and with swipe after swipe nill to nothing. Extremely disappointed answer dissatisfied with the quality for the price.

reviews.t: Some colors are easy and show color quickly
reviews.x: It is ok.  Some colors are easy and show color quickly, others not so quick.  One color didn't wash out for 2 days.  That said, it is still fun to use and if need be I would order it again.
Love the colors but it can be messy make sure to brush the excess off and set with hairspray or it will come off on your neck and finger if you touch your hair a lot.
Besides not really working as shown in the package (the color is never that vivid), this turned my daughter's hair into a lumpy, knotty mess.
These don't work very well on dark brown hair.  Also, some chalk bits tend to fall off when using them.  Otherwise, the kids like the colors.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product fun and easy to use, especially for kids' events and temporary color.
The color washes out easily and doesn't stain clothes or hands for many users.
Several reviewers say the color is not as vibrant as advertised, particularly on darker hair.
Some users report the formula is messy, chunky, or goopy rather than a chalky texture.
A few reviewers note it takes effort or time to build up a good base of color.
